_comment: Source of truth for pinned versions. 'deps' are vendored frontend libs under vendor/ (looked up on npm); 'tools' are dev-only CLI tools (looked up on npm or pypi per 'source'). Renovate reads this file and opens a forge PR when a newer version is published; a 'deps' PR changes only the pin, so re-download the lib into vendor/ and update its Version line in vendor/NOTICES.md on that branch before merging. check-refactor.sh reads its tool versions from here.
